verdict.rationale: Resend documents receiving inbound email: you point MX records at Resend, process messages via webhooks, and list received emails through the API. That covers POSTing to an endpoint and storing messages. Nothing in the evidence shows a rules engine that matches on recipient or pattern and routes to different actions, so routing logic would have to be written in your own webhook handler. Missing for 10: recipient/pattern-matching routing rules, forwarding action, per-rule distinct endpoints, in-depth inbound docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
